title: DATESBETWEEN with a BLANK start begins at the first date of the column
query: EVALUATE VAR R = DATESBETWEEN ( 'Date'[Date], BLANK (), DATE ( 2023, 1, 31 ) ) RETURN ROW ( "Min", MINX ( R, 'Date'[Date] ), "Max", MAXX ( R, 'Date'[Date] ), "Days", COUNTROWS ( R ), "Sales", CALCULATE ( [Sales], R ) )

source.quote: If StartDate is BLANK , DATESBETWEEN starts from the first date in the Dates column.

derivation: The Date table starts on 2023-01-01, so the result is January 2023: 31 days. Sales in January 2023: 30.
